## Exploring the Iris Dataset

This plot shows the relationship between sepal length and petal length for three different iris species.

```{r}
ggplot(iris, aes(x = Sepal.Length, y = Petal.Length, color = Species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Iris Flower Measurements",
    x = "Sepal Length (cm)",
    y = "Petal Length (cm)",
    color = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
